standing: presentation baseline only — craft continuity, never semantic truth
family: episteme register histories (10 HISTORY.md records), carried in roz-histories
lineage_chain: O:I global → Epi global → roz-corpus-base → family-history (this file) → record variant → scene override
attitude: a history is a stream of the Logos in time: one stream-line with stations marking the record's own sections; the record's opening movement is the body

entities.stream: one wide thin square as the stream-line
entities.stations: 3–5 discs, one per leading section of the record (capped at 5), placed along the stream in record order
entities.entity_ceiling: never more than 10 formations per scene (native limit; 6 is this family's max)

text_layers.editorial_card: kicker '<record_id> · HISTORY' (these HISTORY.md records declare no claim_status frontmatter — their DEVELOPMENT companions carry Argued; kicker says HISTORY rather than inventing a status) · title · italic = declared movement refs (frontmatter movement_ids, capped '+n more'; exact list in the binding) + domain
text_layers.body: the record's opening movement, compressed from the record only

variation_rules: stream accent varies by domain (presentation only, recorded per scene in the binding)
station count follows the record's own sections; never padded
no ornament without an argumentative job
